title: Exhibition: Making Ground: Selected Works from the Class of 2026 — Closes
description: This summer, the Art and Design Gallery presents Making Ground: Selected Works from the Class of 2026, a curated selection of highlights from the annual Graduating Student Exhibition (GSE).

title: Exhibition: Doll Dressing — Opens
venue: Special Exhibitions Gallery, The Museum at FIT
description: Doll Dressing centers on the longstanding connections between dolls and high fashion. Historically, dolls operated as miniature fashion models—shipped around Europe and abroad, communicating the latest styles in three-dimensional detail.

title: 27th on Sale: Benefiting Tomorrow's Creatives
description: FIT presents 27th on Sale, an experiential shopping event in FIT's John E. Reeves Great Hall. The showcase features a curated multibrand designer sample sale with apparel, accessories, beauty, and fragrance.

title: Exhibition: Soil to Surface — Opens
description: Soil to Surface highlights the creations of small-scale women farmers, women's cooperatives, and internationally recognized designers from Türkiye, alongside the work of School of Art and Design students, faculty, and alumni at FIT.
